description: Proper accounting for your transport empire. Replaces the Finances tab of the finance window with an Income Statement, Cash Flow Statement and Balance Sheet built from the game's own numbers. Capital expenditure never reduces operating profit, loans are financing (not income), vehicle depreciation uses the game's own values, and the cash flow reconciles to your bank account. Reporting only: it never changes the economy.
